EIP-8295 按周期的状态分层
summary: rjl493456442 改进 EIP-8037 中 EIP-7702 授权的 gas 计算并合并，状态 gas 按授权带来的净状态变化收取。chunter-cb 提交 EIP-8130 修改，让 `authenticateActor` 一次返回 scope、策略类型和策略目标，并为 ERC-8168（8130 付款服务）开讨论帖。weiihann 提交两种状态分层方案（EIP-8295、EIP-8296），让写入长期不活跃状态更贵。屏蔽票据转移 ERC-8290 合并。

items.title: EIP-8037：改进 EIP-7702 授权的 gas 计算
items.note: （rjl493456442）合并，覆盖同一交易内撤销授权等边界情况。状态 gas 现与授权带来的净状态变化一致，唯一例外是清除已有授权不退款，这是有意为之。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: improve EIP-7702 authorization gas accounting
items.note_en: (rjl493456442), merged, covering corner cases such as cancelling an authorization within the same transaction. State gas now matches the net state changes from authorizations, except that clearing a pre-existing authorization is intentionally not refunded.

items.title: EIP-8130：`authenticateActor` 返回 scope、policyType、policyTarget
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。此前只返回 scope 字节，修改后一次调用即可得到解析出的 actor 的完整授权面。EIP-8130：RLP ABI 修正 提交并合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: `authenticateActor` returns scope, policyType, policyTarget
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. It used to return only the scope byte; now one call surfaces the resolved actor's full authorization surface. EIP-8130: RLP ABI correction, submitted and merged.

items.title: 新 EIP：按周期的状态分层
items.note: （weiihann）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 23:40，即 EIP-8295。它读取 EIP-8188 记录的 `last_written_block`，写入约一年未改动的状态比写入最近修改过的状态更贵；读取不变，也不删除或过期任何状态。另提交 固定截止点的状态分层（EIP-8296）。
items.title_en: New EIP: State Tiering by Periods
items.note_en: (weiihann), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 23:40; this is EIP-8295. It reads the `last_written_block` recorded by EIP-8188, so writing to state untouched for roughly a year costs more than writing to recently mutated state; reads are unchanged and nothing is removed or expired. Fixed-Cutoff State Tiering (EIP-8296) was also submitted.

keywords_en: EIP-7702 authorization gas accounting in EIP-8037
summary_en: rjl493456442 improved EIP-7702 authorization gas accounting in EIP-8037 and it was merged, charging state gas by the net state change an authorization causes. chunter-cb submitted an EIP-8130 change so that `authenticateActor` returns scope, policy type and policy target in one call, and opened a thread for ERC-8168 (payer services for 8130). weiihann submitted two state tiering designs (EIP-8295, EIP-8296) that make writes to long inactive state more expensive. The shielded note teleportation ERC-8290 was merged.
